entities.name: Run readable Semantic source from a command
entities.summary: Read one bounded source stream, compile it through the accepted named language, and emit one canonical reference-interpreter observation.

acceptance: One file or stdin source produces one canonical surface-run observation
Source rejection remains distinct from nested kernel outcomes
Invocation and host I/O failures never masquerade as semantic observations
Bun and Node emit byte-identical stdout
The command invokes only the reference interpreter

relations.summary: The accepted compiler remains the sole authority for readable source.
The reference interpreter remains the sole execution authority.
Adds a stateless readable-source process adapter over the kernel.
